be itching to verb

also can’t wait to, itching, excited to, so excited to, be dying to, I’m dying to know

classical

Traupman 101, 155
Cic.
Traupman 101: gestiō quidem (+ inf.)
Traupman 335

gestiō, gestīre

verb, fourth conjugation

+ infinitive.

Other words

  • aveō, avēre — long, be eager (to)

    verb, second conjugation, with an infinitive · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 1.15: valdē aveō scīre quid agās (Lewis & Short); Traupman 337

Examples

  • «Gestiō gustāre!» «Post cēnam gustābimus.»

    “I’m itching to taste it!” “We’ll taste it after dinner.”Libellus IV, Diēs Grātulātiōnis

  • Quid agās, valdē aveō scīre.

    I’m dying to know how you are doing.Cic. Att. 1.15 (Lewis & Short s.v. aveō: valdē aveō scīre quid agās); Traupman 337

See also be in suspense.
